summary: Tested the dynamic production pipeline for Video Production (/video-production) on both backend and frontend. Backend: rewrote /app/backend/tests/test_video_production.py to use the new 'advance' + 'link' API. 9/9 tests pass. They cover pipeline_steps validation (missing name, zero or two filming steps, duplicate key, registrar 403), adding a custom step with a generated key and auto link label, reordering, blocking removal of a step that has sessions on it (400 with Arabic message naming the step), advance/back (requested blocked, confirmed→first step, back from first step→confirmed, link required with Arabic error, links stored in session.links[key], actual_minutes on the filming step, no advance past the last step, no stall on requested or last step), pct per session (20/40/60/80/100 with 5 steps), contract percent / production_percent / lectures_published, 60-minute parts accepted and 61 rejected, payments, contract and session PDFs, teacher /my/contracts settings.steps, and access isolation. Checked the notifications collection: the teacher is notified for confirm, filmed, the custom notify=true step, published and stall, and not for editing, cloud or back. Frontend: everything requested works (StepsEditor add/label/notify/up-down/filming radio/delete/save message and empty-name error; custom step shows as studio KPI chip and in the session pipeline header; vp-sd-next shows the next step name; link input only when needed; missing-link error; back; vp-sd-link-{key}; list badge with mini bar; contract detail's two bars and part chips with %).

minor.issue: New step keys come from f"st_{ObjectId()}"[-12:], which cuts off the 'st_' prefix, so keys are bare hex (e.g. cbc37bf3dcb3). It works, but the prefix was probably meant to stay: use 'st_' + str(ObjectId())[-8:].

After 'back', advancing again sends the teacher a second notification for the same step. Observed: two 'تم التصوير' and two custom-step notifications for one part. 'back' also leaves links[step] and actual_minutes in place.

Moving the is_filming flag or reordering steps changes lectures_completed and recording accrual for existing contracts. Accrual can drop below the amount already paid, giving a negative balance. No warning or guard.
No state check: unstall is accepted in any status.

issues: Native browser date/time pickers (mm/dd/yyyy) are used for vp-s-from/vp-s-to/vp-sd-date/vp-sd-start. Existing issue, not part of this change.

action_items: Optional: keep the 'st_' prefix when generating step keys
Optional: skip the teacher notification when a step is entered again after 'back' (or dedupe it); consider clearing links[step] on back
Optional: warn when changing the filming step or step order would change accrual for contracts that already have payments
critical_code_review_comments: my_contracts calls _flow(db) inside the per-contract loop (extra settings query per contract). Load it once before the loop.

Flow.busy includes every post-filming step, so a part at editing/cloud/published keeps its studio slot. That is fine for past dates, but if the meaning is 'filming done', those steps could be left out of the conflict check.
video_production.py is 849 lines (more than 700). Consider splitting settings/contracts/sessions/my routes into separate modules.
seed_data_creation: None kept. Test contracts TEST_VP رياضيات and TEST_UI_VP (with their sessions and notifications) were created and then hard-deleted by id. TEST_FLOW and its session were also deleted from vp_contracts/vp_sessions, as the briefing allowed. pipeline_steps restored to the 4 defaults (filmed, editing, cloud, published); max_part_minutes=60; both studios unchanged. The main agent's earlier custom step 'مراجعة علمية' was removed, as requested. vp_contracts and vp_sessions are now empty.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run pytest from /app/backend with REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL exported; no xdist or pytest.ini. The suite restores the default 4 steps in teardown and writes created ids to /tmp/vp_test_ids.txt; /tmp/vp_cleanup.py <file> hard-deletes those ids. UI login: first input username, second password, button 'تسجيل الدخول', then go to /video-production.
